semiconductor_relevance: Medium — AL Corporation provides various parts and support services relevant to semiconductor manufacturing but does not directly engage in fabrication or advanced semiconductor technologies.
summary: AL Corporation is a technical trading company that specializes in sourcing and providing customer support services for semiconductor manufacturing components. They offer a range of services including genuine and reverse-engineered parts, repairs, refurbishments, and recycling, catering to the needs of process design engineers in the semiconductor and LCD sectors.
capabilities: Sourcing of genuine and reverse-engineered semiconductor parts
Repairs and refurbishments of semiconductor equipment
Supply of UHV components and sputtering vacuum deposition equipment
Material selection and surface treatment components
